title: Dynamics of Development Religious Moderation: Lessons from Multiethnic Transmigration Communities in Banggai, Central Sulawesi, Indonesia
core_idea: Examine the dynamics of multiethnic transmigration communities in Simpang Raya, Banggai, and explore the role of diverse ethnic and religious leaders and institutions in promoting sustainable religious moderation using a descriptive qualitative method with purposive sampling.
tldr: A qualitative study investigating how ethnic and religious leaders and local institutions may support religious moderation in multiethnic transmigration communities in Simpang Raya, Banggai.
